title: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show
question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned in that department, and the maximum total units for any subject in that department during the same term, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    cco.SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cco.GRADE_TYPE,
    SUM(cco.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  WHERE cco.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'
  GROUP BY cco.SUBJECT_ID, cco.SUBJECT_TITLE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.GRADE_TYPE
),
dept_max_units AS (
  SELECT
    cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(cco.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco
  WHERE cco.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'
  GROUP BY cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
student_counts AS (
  SELECT
    msd.DEPARTMENT,
    COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS active_grad_student_count
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  WHERE msd.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
    AND msd.OFFICE_LOCATION <> ''
    AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G'
  GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT
  b.SUBJECT_ID,
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.sum_lecture_units,
  COALESCE(sc.active_grad_student_count, 0) AS active_grad_student_count,
  dmu.max_total_units
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN dept_max_units dmu ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE = b.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN student_counts sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = b.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY b.SUBJECT_ID
